name: mcp-commander-cognitive
description: Cognitive architecture cartridge implementing 9 background operations for engineering design intelligence: divergent thinking, convergent thinking, cross-domain transfer, uncommon methods, pattern recognition, compression thinking, spatial reasoning, context diagnostics, and design rationale.

tools.name: divergent_thinking
tools.description: Generate alternative design approaches for a given design intent or constraint set

tools.name: convergent_thinking
tools.description: Evaluate and rank design alternatives against constraints (cost, weight, manufacturability, strength)

tools.name: cross_domain_transfer
tools.description: Transfer proven design solutions from one industry domain to another

tools.name: uncommon_methods
tools.description: Suggest non-traditional manufacturing methods (3D printed jigs, foam tooling, additive casting, etc.)

tools.name: pattern_recognition
tools.description: Identify recurring design inefficiencies and patterns across projects

tools.name: compression_thinking
tools.description: Simplify over-engineered assemblies by identifying redundant features and consolidation opportunities

tools.name: spatial_reasoning
tools.description: Infer 3D spatial relationships from voice/text descriptions of geometry

tools.name: context_diagnostics
tools.description: Identify missing constraints, incomplete definitions, and gaps in a design description

tools.name: design_rationale
tools.description: Capture and retrieve design rationale linking decisions to engineering requirements
